comparison.objective: Assemble a polarized 2×2 battery pack in a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated tight-clearance cell insertion, polarity control and alignment of two holder halves.
comparison.success_condition: Bottom holder centered, four cells seated positive-up, top holder centered, assembly still and released.
comparison.reason: Tests repeated component insertion and orientation in a fixture, with no retained rotary adjustment or closed-loop dynamic-response calibration.
